changesApplied.changeMade: Refactored metrics initialization to write to SurrealDB first via create_metrics(), then cache in Redis. Added proper error handling where Redis failure is non-fatal but SurrealDB failure is logged.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces cache-aside pattern specified in Phase 3 trace: SurrealDB is primary storage, Redis is cache layer. Metrics must persist beyond Redis cache eviction. Aligns with template write pattern (already SurrealDB-first at lines 342-348).
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - Additive change. create_template now writes both template and metrics to SurrealDB before caching. Backward compatible with existing Redis-only deployments. No breaking changes to API contracts.

highPriority.gap: Uses Redis-first pattern with compensating rollback. Should be SurrealDB-first with Redis cache update.

mediumPriority.gap: No SurrealDB fallback on Redis cache miss. No selection tracking in SurrealDB.
mediumPriority.complexity: MEDIUM - Add fallback logic and selection tracking
